engine: Local MySQL dialect planner/formatter contract; no server required
case: Word-character MySQL delimiter adjacent to a routine keyword
contract: A routine terminated by the word-character delimiter xyz adjacent to END remains one planned statement, and the following SELECT remains a separate statement.
The delimiter text inside a quoted routine string and its placeholder-shaped text do not terminate the routine or escape parameter extraction.
Formatting preserves the DELIMITER directive and reparsing preserves statement count and the sole trailing-query parameter.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app mysql_word_character_delimiter_stops_at_keyword_boundary -- --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other delimiter forms and human approval behavior for unparseable routines remain open.
